title: Move catalog prices to minor units
pr_body: Keeps catalog rates as integer minor units and adds invoice line notes.
author: codex
provenance: Original synthetic production-style change authored for benchmark v2.

bugs.title: Invoice amount multiplies minor-unit rate by 100 again
bugs.rationale: The changed catalog contract returns cents, while the changed invoice caller still converts dollars to cents. Every new invoice is billed at one hundred times the catalog price.
